provenance: Reverse-engineered from ~50 operator rejections across acts 1-5. Every invariant below cost at least one paid regeneration and one review round before it was written down.

invariants.prompt_clause: the reservoir water sits FLUSH with the very top of the concrete parapet wall, brim-full — it does NOT sit low in the basin and the level does NOT drop
invariants.why: 8 rejections across acts 2-4; the operator finally drew a red line on a screenshot. The whole story is a reservoir that is always dangerously full.

invariants.prompt_clause: ALL water, spray, debris and rubble move strictly DOWNHILL and OUTWARD away from the reservoir — never uphill, never back into the lake
invariants.why: 4 rejections: water flowing up over the dam, rubble flowing into the lake, a breach venting inward.

invariants.prompt_clause: the dam wall is INTACT — no breach, no torn gap, no collapsed section, no flood downstream (the failure happens later in the film)
invariants.why: act-1 note '00:43 this take has the dam break already'. Pre-breach beats must not spoil the failure.

invariants.prompt_clause: show the person as a WHOLE recognizable figure with visible face and body, doing the action — never a disembodied hand, floating limb or cropped fragment
invariants.why: 'there is just a hand sticking out from under a console' (seg_012) and a second mismatched-hands shot. Fragment shots read as errors, not style.

invariants.prompt_clause: in plan the reservoir is KIDNEY-BEAN shaped with a pinched waist — never a circle or a clean oval
invariants.why: seg_006_b1 came back a perfect round ring; every other aerial in the film is the kidney silhouette.

invariants.prompt_clause: the ORIGINAL reservoir is a rockfill ring topped by a thin concrete parapet and has NO spillway and NO overflow drain — do not add one
invariants.why: the narration's central fact ('no spillway, nowhere for the water to go'). A generated spillway contradicts the thesis.

invariants.prompt_clause: the REBUILT reservoir is smooth stepped mass concrete WITH an engineered spillway channel — not the old rockfill-and-parapet construction
invariants.why: the rebuild must read as visibly different engineering from the thing that failed.

invariants.prompt_clause: it is about 5 a.m. in mid-December in the Missouri Ozarks — winter darkness or bare pre-dawn grey, leafless trees, no summer foliage
invariants.why: a cold-open beat came back as a wrecked TOWN in the wrong season/setting; the disaster is one isolated house in a bare winter forest.

invariants.prompt_clause: the only building in the flood path is ONE small isolated wooden park-superintendent house in forest — never a town, street, or row of buildings
invariants.why: 'where did this clip come from? this is a town, it doesn't match'. No settlement was hit; that is why the story has no dead.
